# ninja build file for plan805-probe with msvc compiler

# includes
includes = -I../include -I../路径 中文

# defines
defines = /DDEBUG=1 /DVERSION=2

# cflags
cflags = /O2 /W3 /MD

# rules
rule as
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/ml64.exe -I../include -I../路径 中文 /O2 /W3 /MD /Fo$out $in
    description = Assembling $in

rule cc
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/cl.exe /c -I../include -I../路径 中文 /DDEBUG=1 /DVERSION=2 /O2 /W3 /MD /Fo$out $in
    description = Compiling $in

rule link
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/link.exe /OUT:$out $in $ldflags $libs
    description = Linking $out

rule lib
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/lib.exe /OUT:$out $in
    description = Building library $out

# build objects for target app
build main.obj: cc ../src/main.c
# target executable
build app.exe: link main.obj
# build objects for target math
build math.obj: cc ../math/math.c
# target library
build math.lib: lib math.obj

# build objects for target t
build test.obj: cc ../t/test.c
# target executable
build t.exe: link test.obj
